text.title: Agency Discovery Call Scorecard Failure Modes
text.summary: Six antipatterns observed when applying Agency Discovery Call Scorecard. Each pairs symptom + root-cause + concrete fix. Detector clauses make them mechanically catchable.

antipattern.symptom: Two reps score the same recorded call; totals differ by 20 or more points, mostly on `fit`.

root-cause.source: behaviourally anchored rating scales (Smith and Kendall, 1963)

antipattern.root-cause: Anchors are "poor / good / excellent" instead of observable ICP criteria.
antipattern.fix: Rewrite anchors as facts per `r-anchors-are-observable-facts`; re-score the last week's calls to confirm agreement.

antipattern.symptom: No lead ever reaches the threshold, or several leads exceed 100.
antipattern.root-cause: An axis was added or removed without renormalising weights.
antipattern.fix: Renormalise to 1.0 per `r-weights-sum-to-one-no-dominant-axis`, bump the rubric version, do not rescore old leads on the new version.

antipattern.symptom: Leads advanced at high `decision_maker` scores stall at proposal stage while "checking with the partner".
antipattern.root-cause: Axis scored from the CRM title or the prospect's claim, not verified authority on the call.
antipattern.fix: Score on confirmed sign-off per `r-decision-maker-scored-on-verified-authority`; default to the lowest anchor when authority was not discussed.

antipattern.symptom: Rubric has "advance above 70, reject below 50, discuss in between"; most leads land in between and the pipeline meeting re-litigates each one.
antipattern.root-cause: Threshold split into a band to avoid hard rejects.
antipattern.fix: Collapse to one number per `r-single-threshold-inside-range`; route below-threshold leads to nurture rather than to a meeting.

antipattern.symptom: Scorecards filled in on Friday for Monday's calls; evidence notes empty; scores cluster at the rep's favourite anchor.
antipattern.root-cause: No 24-hour rule and no evidence field enforced.
antipattern.fix: Enforce `r-scored-within-24h-with-evidence`; a score with an empty evidence note does not count for the advance decision.

antipattern.symptom: Retro compares this week's advance rate to last week's; the weights changed on Wednesday; the comparison is meaningless and nobody notices.
antipattern.root-cause: Weights or anchors edited without a version bump.
antipattern.fix: Version every change per `r-versioned-weekly-calibration`; the retro compares only leads scored under one version.
